national_news.title: Government Priority on Cost-Effective and High-Quality Infrastructure: Nitin Gadkari
bullets: Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari addressed the fourth edition of the Tunnels and Bridges Conference 2026 in New Delhi.
The Ministry is preparing tunnel tenders worth Rs 2 to 2.5 lakh crore, focusing on advanced technologies like precast methodology and Tunnel Boring Machines.
The Ministry plans to review subcontracting provisions and link consultant tender eligibility to performance assessments of Detailed Project Reports (DPRs).

national_news.title: RDI Fund Features Stringent Safeguards to Protect Taxpayers' Money and Private Capital
bullets: Science and Technology Minister Dr Jitendra Singh chaired the monthly joint meeting of Science Secretaries in New Delhi.
The Research, Development, and Innovation (RDI) Fund involves a shared responsibility with 50 per cent of investment expected from private equity sources.
Inter-ministerial consultations are underway to make the RDI Fund framework more inclusive for strategic technology requirements.

national_news.title: Delhi Flags Off 200 Zero-Emission Electric Buses to Expand Green Fleet
bullets: Delhi Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu and Chief Minister Rekha Gupta flagged off 200 new zero-emission electric buses from the Delhi University Sports Complex.
The addition pushes Delhi's electric bus fleet beyond 5,000, with a total bus fleet of around 6,800, under plans to reach 14,000 buses by 2028-29.
A new Delhi-Karnal interstate e-bus service and 56 dedicated Ladies Special e-bus services integrated with the Delhi Police 112 emergency system were also launched.

national_news.title: India's Economic Growth Driven by Infrastructure, Inclusion, and Manufacturing: Ashwini Vaishnaw
bullets: Union I&B Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated at the UP-Japan Investment Summit 2026 that India's economy is growing in the 6 to 8 percent range, supported by robust public investment of around USD 130 billion annually.

Key infrastructural milestones highlighted include 99.6 percent railway network electrification, addition of 38,000 km of railway lines, and the world's second-largest road network with 65,000 km of new highways.
UP Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath noted that the state has tripled its budget and per capita income over nine years, hosting over 96 lakh MSME units and 22,000 start-ups.

national_news.title: Indian Shuttlers Advance at BWF World Championships in New Delhi
bullets: Mixed doubles pair Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto entered the pre-quarterfinals of the BWF World Championships held at the Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, New Delhi.
Top Indian pairs like Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty advanced after a walkover in the tournament.
Young shuttler Ayush Shetty previously produced a major upset by defeating world number one and defending champion Shi Yu Qi of China.

national_news.title: Lakshya Sen and Other Indians Progress at BWF World Championships
bullets: Ace shuttler Lakshya Sen advanced to the men's singles second round at the BWF Badminton World Championships after defeating Austria's Collins Filimon.
Women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand moved into the pre-quarterfinals after defeating the US pair Lauren Lam and Allison Lee.
Unnati Hooda also advanced to the second round in women's singles by overcoming Myanmar's Thet Htar Thuzar in straight games.

national_news.title: India and Malaysia Deepen Cooperation in Public Administration and Governance
bullets: India and Malaysia held the 2nd India-Malaysia Joint Working Group (JWG) meeting to strengthen bilateral cooperation in public administration, capacity building, and governance reforms.
Discussions highlighted India's CPGRAMS platform and the AI-enabled voice chatbot 'Samadhan Didi' launched by DARPG on May 30, 2026, for citizen-centric grievance redressal.
The Malaysian side presented the Action Plan for the Malaysia-India Governance Partnership: 2027-2029 to implement various areas under the MoU.

national_news.title: India's Medical Tourism Sector Valued at $8.7 Billion in 2025, Projected to Reach $16.2 Billion by 2030
bullets: India's medical tourism market reached approximately $8.7 billion in 2025, drawing over 5.07 lakh foreign patients, and is projected to scale up to $16.2 billion by 2030.
Top source countries for medical tourists in 2025 included Bangladesh, Iraq, Uzbekistan, Somalia, Turkmenistan, Oman, and Kenya.
India ranks 10th globally among medical tourism destinations and features prominently in wellness tourism spanning AYUSH practices.

national_news.title: PIB Dehradun Organises Regional Media Workshop 'Vartalaap' in Chamoli
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB), Dehradun, organised a regional media workshop titled 'Vartalaap' in Gopeshwar, Chamoli, on August 20, 2026.
The workshop aims to enhance awareness of central government welfare schemes, including Ayushman Bharat, PM Matru Vandana Yojana, and Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan.
It focuses on strengthening last-mile communication in rural and border areas regarding development initiatives, GI tags, and ODOP.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Proposes Month-Long Youth Campaign at PSB Confluence 2026
bullets: The two-day PSB Confluence 2026 was organised in New Delhi by the Department of Financial Services (DFS), Ministry of Finance.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a focused, month-long campaign starting October 2, 2026, aimed at youth above 16 years to integrate them into the formal financial system.
The initiative will be coordinated through the Indian Banks' Association (IBA) via a common online portal and physical outreach across educational and skilling institutions.

national_news.title: 97th Annual General Meeting of ICAR Society Emphasizes Integrated Farming for Small Farmers
bullets: The 97th Annual General Meeting of the ICAR Society was held at the National Agricultural Science Complex (NASC), New Delhi, chaired by Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan.
Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan emphasized integrated farming systems and demand-driven agricultural research to diversify incomes of small and marginal farmers.
Discussions focused on achieving agricultural self-reliance, climate-resilient practices, improved soil health, and strengthening FPOs in alignment with Viksit Bharat 2047.

national_news.title: India's FTA Landscape and Export Performance Show Steady Growth
bullets: Combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion in FY 2025-26, with merchandise exports at US$ 441.8 billion.
During April-June 2026 (FY 2026-27), combined exports were estimated at US$ 232.73 billion, marking an 11.37% year-on-year increase.

The India-UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), signed in a record 88 days and operational since May 2022, made the UAE India's largest individual FTA export market at US$ 37,359.11 million in FY 2025-26.

national_news.title: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports Announces National Sports Awards 2025
bullets: The National Sports Awards 2025 selection committee was chaired by retired Supreme Court Justice Arun Kumar Mishra.
Prominent athletes such as Tejaswin Shankar (Athletics), Treesa Jolly (Badminton), and Divya Jitendra Deshmukh (Chess) were named for the prestigious Arjuna Award 2025.
The Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar 2025 was awarded to the Army Paralympic Node, Pune, for its contribution to sports promotion.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Government Initiatives on Infrastructure and Development
bullets: The Kosi-Mechi inter-state river link project aims to expand irrigation in the Seemanchal region, enhancing farmers' prosperity and water management.
Approval has been granted for the upgradation of the Muzaffarpur-Sitamarhi-Sonbarsa four-lane highway.

Infrastructure including road and water facilities for the Gaya Integrated Manufacturing Cluster (IMC) is targeted for completion before 2027, with water planned to be brought from the Sone to the Falgu river.

bihar_news.title: Cabinet Secretariat Department Functions and Key Contacts in Bihar
bullets: The Cabinet Secretariat Department is responsible for organizing Council of Ministers meetings, inter-departmental coordination, and formulating executive rules.
Shri Pratyaya Amrit serves as the Chief Secretary of Bihar according to the department's directory.
Key administrative functions include protocol execution and management of the Bihar State Archives Directorate.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Gambling Prohibition Act and Centre's RMG Ban
bullets: Compares Bihar's state-specific Gambling Prohibition Act with the Central Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025 (PROG Act).
PROG Act rules were notified on April 24, 2026.
Highlights legislative differences between state and central frameworks on online gaming and gambling.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves Two Sugar Mill Projects Worth Rs 422.5 Crore in East Champaran
bullets: The Bihar cabinet approved two sugar mill projects with a total investment of Rs 422.5 crore in East Champaran district.
Shree Ganesh Sugar Mills Private Limited will set up a Rs 180 crore project with a 5,000 TCD sugar mill and distillery at Chorma in Pakridayal block.
Rajshree Sugars received approval for a Rs 242.5 crore project featuring a 5,000 TCD sugar mill, a 28 MW co-generation plant, and a 60 KLPD distillery at Kanjahiya Tola in Kotwa block.
Projects will benefit sugarcane farmers in Motihari, Madhuban, Chiraiya, Sheohar, and Nepal's Terai region while creating local employment.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Agri-PV Summit 2026 Explores Integration of Farming and Solar Energy
bullets: The Bihar Agri-PV Summit 2026 was held in Patna to promote the integration of agriculture and solar power generation.
Experts highlighted that agri-photovoltaic models can optimize fertile yet limited land in Bihar to boost farmers' incomes.
The initiative aims to support wider adoption of clean energy and help the state achieve its renewable energy targets.

bihar_news.title: Ministry of Railways Sanctions Sherghati-Kajree New Broad Gauge Line Project
bullets: The Ministry of Railways sanctioned the Sherghati-Kajree New Broad Gauge Line Project with a total estimated cost of Rs 26.27 billion.
The project involves the development of a 107.89 km long new Broad Gauge railway line connecting Sherghati in Bihar to Kajree in Jharkhand.
The project will be executed under the East Central Railway (ECR) zone, covering civil engineering, signaling, telecommunication, and electrical works.

bihar_news.title: Legal Status of Passports and Electoral Verification in India
bullets: The Ministry of External Affairs clarified that an Indian passport is primarily a travel document issued under the Passports Act, 1967, rather than conclusive proof of citizenship.

The Supreme Court in May 2026 upheld the Election Commission's authority to conduct the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Bihar under Article 324 and the Representation of the People Act, 1950.
The Court noted that the EC's power to assess citizenship is limited and prima facie, as final citizenship determinations remain exclusively under the Citizenship Act, 1955.

bihar_news.title: India's Robust Electoral Framework and Global Recognition
bullets: US President Donald Trump praised India's voter identification system and voter verification model during discussions citing the scale of Indian elections.
India's electoral framework relies on independent constitutional oversight by the Election Commission of India under Article 324, managing hundreds of millions of voters.
The multi-layered security and verification process includes Booth Level Officers, Electronic Voting Machines (EVMs), VVPATs, and political party scrutiny agents.

bihar_news.title: Bihar's Critical Mineral Potential Offers New Investment Opportunities
bullets: Bihar Deputy Chief Minister/Minister highlighted the state's critical mineral potential to attract investments.
The initiative aims to boost industrial innovation and harness unexplored mineral resources in Bihar.
The focus is on driving economic growth and infrastructure development through local resource utilization.

bihar_news.title: Patna Metro Receives INR 628.32 Crore Funding Under Centre's Capital Investment Scheme
bullets: Patna Metro has been allocated INR 628.32 crore under the Central government's capital investment scheme.
The additional financial backing aims to accelerate ongoing construction work across the project's corridors.
The funding highlights central support for urban mass transit infrastructure development in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Allocate 30+ Coal Blocks to Boost Mining Sector
bullets: The Bihar government plans to allocate over 30 coal blocks to boost the state's mining and industrial activities.
The initiative aims to address the growing infrastructure needs of the state by utilizing local stone and minerals.
The coal block allocations are targeted to be finalized to accelerate regional development projects.

bihar_news.title: Bihar initiates site survey for 129 EV charging stations across 23 districts
bullets: Site surveys have begun for establishing 129 Electric Vehicle (EV) charging stations spanning 23 districts in Bihar.
The initiative is spearheaded by Raj Kumar to build a robust electric mobility infrastructure network in the state.
Promoting clean energy transport is a top priority for the state government's sustainable development goals.

bihar_news.title: Bihar inaugurates mineral block auctions, plans mining start by October 15
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary inaugurated the auction of strategic mineral blocks and the National Mineral Exploration Trust (NMET) workshop in Patna.
The state government aims to allocate over 30 out of 44 surveyed mineral blocks before September 30.
Mineral-rich districts highlighted include Rohtas (limestone), Aurangabad, Jehanabad, Jamui, Gaya, Banka, and Bhagalpur, with royalties dedicated to public welfare.

bihar_news.title: Overview of Bihar Cabinet Secretariat Department and Administrative Setup
bullets: The Cabinet Secretariat Department handles the organization of Council of Ministers meetings and inter-departmental coordination in Bihar.
Shri Pratyaya Amrit, I.A.S., serves as the Chief Secretary of Bihar under this administrative setup.
Key functions include formulating executive rules for government work, handling state protocol, and managing administrative notifications.
